## Mission

You are the cross-model reviewer for plan 009-embed-split — chunked embeddings + input hygiene. The composed implementation of three units (u1 store, u2 enrich, u3 search read) is complete on branch 009-embed-split. Judge whether the code makes the plan's promises TRUE — plan fidelity, correctness, and composition seams (where units meet is where it breaks) — and return findings the PM can act on. You are READ-ONLY on the code. Verdict goes to the PM (pij-associated-owl), who relays it with its own judgment attached.

| i2b | WHERE THE AUTHORS ARE LEAST CONFIDENT — hunt here first (the PM owes you this list and it is honest): (a) u1's ATOMICITY of a multi-chunk write — if N chunk rows for one source_hash can be observed half-written, `existing_embedding_hashes` (crates/store/src/embeddings.rs:120-146) reports a partially-embedded hash as DONE and the tail is silently lost forever, which no unit test can see from the inside; (b) u2's chunk_plan BYTE-vs-CHAR boundary arithmetic — estimate_tokens counts bytes (crates/core/src/tokens.rs:58-60) and slicing a String mid-codepoint panics the enrichment runner; (c) u3's LIMIT semantics — collapsing AFTER the LIMIT looks correct in a one-element fixture and still lets a whale crowd out every other element; (d) the COMPOSED interaction of u1's heal with u2's mint filter — if they disagree about what 'empty' means (trim vs is_empty), the heal retires rows the filter would still mint, a treadmill neither unit's tests can detect. |
| i2c | DISBELIEVE THE AUTHORS' OWN RECEIPTS. Re-derive; do not audit prose. Specifically: (1) the plan claims TWO independently mutation-checked hygiene layers (ac-0004) — actually delete the mint filter, run the suite, observe exactly ONE red; restore; delete the assembly drop, observe exactly the OTHER red. If one deletion reds both, the defense-in-depth is one layer wearing two hats and ac-0004 is FALSE. (2) ac-0002's tail anchor must FAIL with chunking disabled — verify the control leg actually disables chunking rather than merely asserting it does; a tail test that passes with chunking off measures nothing (TENETS tenet 14). (3) ac-0003 has TWO legs — the crowd-out leg is the one that proves LIMIT applies to elements; check it exists and fails when the collapse is removed. (4) ac-0005's heal must be TERMINAL: read the boot sweep predicate at crates/store/src/jobs.rs:431-452 (`WHERE state='failed' AND NOT terminal ...`) and confirm by execution, not by reasoning, that a healed job survives a real `requeue_failed` call. |
| i2d | WHAT IS ALREADY KNOWN-OPEN — spend ZERO findings re-reporting these: (1) BACKLOG ROW 92, the pre-existing raw+smart duplicate-hit defect (the nearest CTE constrains model_key but not source_kind, so a raw and a smart row for the same content can both survive and resolve to the same element). It predates this plan. u3's collapse is expected to close it INCIDENTALLY — your job is to CONFIRM whether it is in fact closed, and say so; not to file it. (2) The `truncated` column and its already-truncated row inventory survive deliberately: the plan's non-goals defer that backfill. Its write path dying while the column stays is CORRECT, not an oversight. (3) The per-input cap WARN surviving as a last-resort guard is deliberate (impl-guide risk register) — it should never fire in practice, and its firing post-merge is the agreed regression signal. (4) ac-0007's post-merge observation leg (krill watching the next real ingest wave) belongs to o-prime, not to this branch. |
| i3 | Priority order: (1) plan promises that are not actually true, (2) COMPOSITION-SEAM defects between units — this plan's three units each touch a different layer of one pipeline and composition is where emergent defects appear (tenet 15), (3) interface drift from the impl-guide's frozen seams, (4) correctness/safety in the changed code, (5) test gaps on the contract. Style noise is unwanted. |
| i3b | FROZEN SEAMS — drift from any of these is a finding, checked explicitly: (S1) the vector key is exactly (source_hash, source_kind, chunk_no, model_key) with chunk_no smallint DEFAULT 0 and existing rows grandfather as chunk 0 with NO backfill. (S2) chunk_plan is a PURE function; a single-chunk input returns exactly one chunk_no=0 entry so the common path is unchanged. (S3) hygiene is TWO predicates at TWO layers. (S4, amended) the element collapse lives INSIDE the store's nearest CTE and NOTHING moved to daemon `fuse` — open crates/daemon/src/search.rs and confirm `fuse`/`same_hit` (:685-715) are untouched, because moving the collapse there would silently change lexical-channel (#74) fusion. ALSO FROZEN: the batch planner's token-budget splitting (TOKEN_BUDGET, split_to_budget per-call SUM) and retry-travels-alone (SOLO_FROM_ATTEMPT) semantics — chunks are just more inputs to the same planner. And JOB IDENTITY: chunks must be inputs WITHIN one job, never N jobs; the dedupe key at crates/daemon/src/enrich.rs:107-112 upserts ON CONFLICT (dedupe_key) SET payload=EXCLUDED.payload, so N chunk jobs would make siblings REPLACE each other's payloads. Verify the built code actually has this property. |
